name: Dick Carr
role: Medora teamster who worked with mules
bio: Dick Carr was a Medora teamster who was kicked by one of his mules in June 1885, and his father came from Delavan, Ill., that September to see him for the first time in twelve years. In 1886 he lost his team of mules south of the Black Hills, and they were still missing that July.

moments.label: Still searching for mules lost south of the Hills

mentions: Dick Carr was kicked yesterday by one of his babies, commonly called mules, and is taking an enforced lay-off of a few days.
John Carr, of Delavan, Ill., is here visiting his son Dick, whom he had not seen for twelve years.

Some time ago, word was received that Dick Carr had lost his team of mules south of the Hills. We learn that they have not yet been recovered.
Dick Carr has not as yet recovered his mules, which strayed away from south of the Black Hills about two months ago. A sharp lookout by our cattlemen may bring them to light,…
